Monte Rocella

Discover an island paradise
in Cabo San Lucas

Escape to Monte Rocella Resort & Spa, where sustainable luxury and premium wellness meet spectacular natural beauty. Located in El Tezal, with incredible ocean views that stretch to the iconic Arch of Cabo San Lucas.

 
Each residence blends contemporary design with the rugged beauty of Baja California — private terraces, heated pools, and curated interiors that feel equally at home for a romantic escape or a family retreat. Managed by Del Mar Boutique, every stay is backed by five-star hospitality and a team that knows Los Cabos inside out.

FAQ

Common questions

Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out may be arranged subject to availability.
Reservations cancelled 30 or more days before arrival receive a full refund. Cancellations within 30 days are non-refundable.
Nightly rates do not include Mexican taxes: IVA (16%) and ISH (5%), totalling 21%. All taxes are itemised before you confirm.
Our standard minimum stay is 2 nights. Peak season may require longer minimums.
Yes — complimentary on-site secure parking is included with every stay.
Monte Rocella offers convenient self check-in. Prior to arrival you’ll receive detailed instructions and access codes. Our concierge team is available via WhatsApp throughout your stay.
